description: Dispute a submitted escrow. Payer or payee, once something was submitted. The dispute goes to the operator queue (GET /disputes/{dispute_id}, POST /disputes/{dispute_id}/respond); the loser pays the $5 dispute fee. Needs can_open_disputes. Answers 501 feature_unavailable while stand-alone escrow is switched off (ESCROW_API_ENABLED).
name: dispute_escrow
title: Dispute a submitted escrow
